Relative LES has cycle-tensor map Phi(c tensor d)=(c_e d_e)_e. Each cactus block cycle has edge-disjoint support and the b oriented cycle vectors form an integral basis of H1(G;Z); off-diagonal products vanish and b diagonal vectors have disjoint primitive support. Therefore Phi's image is saturated rank b, ker rank b(b-1), coker free rank E-b, H1 free rank E+b, H0=Z and no higher cells. Particle swapping induces minus tensor flip on degree-2 products and minus identity on deleted squares; over Q, one +-pair per two distinct graph cycles and H1 +-dimensions b,E. Independent arithmetic: two triangles meeting at one vertex (E=6,b=2) yield (1,8,2), swap H1 (2,6), H2 (1,1); three triangles E=9,b=3 yield (1,12,6). Inspected finite checker uses 4 finite fields and 7 cactus fixtures, not a proof of integral saturation or unbounded class.
